The rules are simple

THE REMATCHES
ARE INEVITABLE.

Smash crates, collect powerups, and catch your rivals in the blast. Last fighter standing wins the round.

01

Bring the whole couch

Versus

Battle friends in local multiplayer, or let bots fill the open seats. Mix keyboards and controllers and keep everyone in the game.

02

Take the festival tour

Region Tour

Fight across Verdantia, earn medals, and challenge the festival’s reigning champion. Choose from four difficulty levels as you find your rhythm.

03

Expect the unexpected

Random Arena

Take on changing, region-themed arena layouts. Find a new route, rethink your traps, and turn unfamiliar ground into an advantage.

A little extra chaos

Gravity, Chain, Ghost, and MegaBlast bomb mutations keep rivals guessing. Collect seven powerups to change your next move.

Your festival, your pace

Keyboard and controller support, four bot difficulty levels, Steam achievements, and Steam Cloud make it easy to keep playing.

MegaBlast Mayhem uses a single shared screen for local play. Online multiplayer is not included.

Play your way

A PLACE FOR
EVERY PLAYER.

Adjust the game to suit your setup, from the first menu to the last round.

  • Keyboard and controller navigation
  • Four bot difficulty levels
  • Separate music and sound-effect controls
  • Windowed, borderless, and fullscreen display options
  • Color modes and distinct player shapes for clearer identification
  • Steam achievements and cloud saves
